summary: Iter 26 Mr Genius commerce actions verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 4 passed + 1 expected skip (Genius non-determinism). Frontend playwright: add_to_cart click updates ja_cart, toasts, flips chip to 'ADDED' emerald state with data-consumed=true; view_order click closes panel and navigates to /orders/{id}; public users get NO action chips; reload + reopen rehydrates persisted action chips from /guardian/history.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor parser edge-case: _ACTIONS_RE in /app/backend/routes/guardian.py requires inner brackets [...] to match. If Genius emits a malformed open-but-no-close-bracket block (e.g. '[ACTIONS]\n[ {bad json\n[/ACTIONS]'), the regex never matches and the [ACTIONS]/[/ACTIONS] tags leak into the visible reply. In practice Claude does not produce this shape, but a defensive fallback regex (\[ACTIONS\][\s\S]*?\[/ACTIONS\]) for the strip step would be safer.

Frontend GuardianBot.jsx: action chips don't truncate long product names beyond 4 words via .split(' ').slice(0,4) — looks fine for current catalogue but could clip non-English (Bangla) names since split is whitespace-only. Minor i18n nit.

Backend insert_many on guardian_messages persists actions on the assistant doc even though the schema migration is implicit — fine for Mongo but worth documenting in README that the field can be missing on pre-iter26 docs (frontend already defaults to []).
No rate-limiting differentiation between authenticated and unauthenticated genius calls — auth users share the same _RATE_MAX=12/min. Consider higher cap for paying workshops in a future iter.
